basis: Dated list price (config/prices.json snapshot in run_meta.json) applied to recorded token counts; not billed. Gemini free tier: actual spend 0 USD (same convention as Weeks 1 and 2).
cost_per_task_definition: mean over all planned cases of the final record's answer-generation tokens at the dated list price; judge, classifier and local retrieval excluded; usage of failed transport attempts is unknown and not included; not billed spend
recorded_calls_note: All recorded generation and judge calls of the first pass and the repair pass; usage of 3 failed transport attempts is unknown, so this is a lower bound.
actual_spend_note: Weeks 1 and 2 reported 0 USD actual spend on the same free tier.
